text: Lambdas were added to Java largely because of interface code.
explanation: `ActionListener` had been a functional interface for sixteen years before there was a notation for it. Every button handler was a five-line anonymous class, and multiplied by every control in an application the noise was the motivating case. Note what that implies: the *concept* never needed lambdas — `Collections.sort` has taken a `Comparator` since 1998 — only the notation did.
